notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you for sticking with us all these years![/h1]

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks [i]eleven[/i] years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

[h2]Then what lies beyond the 11th year?[/h2]

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:[/h3]

[url=bit.ly/dhxp2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Did someone mention sale?[/h2]
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with [b]up to 80% off[/b]!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH

notes.title: DreadHaunt 1.0 Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

We're thrilled to announce that DreadHaunt 1.0 is finally here! After months of hard work, dedication, and countless sleepless nights, we're excited to bring you the full vision of a fun yet scary experience.

This update marks a significant milestone for our team. We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a truly haunting experience, and we can't wait to see what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

[h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Modes: Single Player Campaign[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c1b8e7ad1ee4eaba9a41b02b44ffca8531011c62.gif[/img]
Experience the thrills of DreadHaunt, if you dare, in Single Player mode, And dive deeper into the DreadHaunt universe with an expanded lore.

[h2]Expanded Character Roster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/bc528a019a18950415d750d291efbfca4c234bf8.gif[/img]
DreadHaunt 1.0 features a wider selection of playable characters, both Agents and the Spectromorphs will be unlocked as you play.

[h2][b](Free)[/b] Season Pass: Pilot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b790f03cc736971d180b0176f0ada05afc3be72.jpg[/img]
In addition to new modes, agents, and Spectromorphs, you will also rewarded with more agent costumes, lore entries, titles, alternate NPC ghosts, and many more!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We couldn't have made it this far without your incredible support. Thank you for joining us on this terrifying journey. We can't wait to see what horrors await you in DreadHaunt 1.0.

Thank you for your support, and get haunting!

- Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: Jurig Escape Is Available, For Free!
notes.notes:
In 2010, before Digital Happiness is formed, we made Jurig Escape, a prototype that laid the foundation for our game development journey and would eventually evolve into to DreadOut, our darling title. So in celebration of DreadOut's 10th Anniversary, we made this very same prototype available on steam, completely free of charge, immortalizing it as a significant piece of our game development history.

Jurig Escape offers a brief yet intense survival horror experience that transports you back 14 years, when our passion for making games first ignited. 

Find out more on the store page, and in DreadOut 10th Anniversary sale page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957940/Jurig_Escape/

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DH/sale/dreadout10

notes.title: Decade of Spooks - Celebrating DreadOut 10th Anniversary
notes.notes:
In Digital Happiness, 10 years already we have grown organically with you. 

At this moment, I would like to say deep thanks to our team, partners, media, and most importantly, you the gamers, that has been very supportive along the way.

Despite all the shortcomings that exist, every support and good appreciation from you are very important to us.  
Without your support, Digital Happiness would not be here at the moment.
Here at Digital Happiness, we can't wait to present you our best creation from us.
You are the reason for us that keeps our spirits alive, to keep making our best creations.  

So on this occasion, we present you with our first 10th anniversary of DreadOut Sale Event.

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DH/sale/dreadout10


We're also hosting an exclusive reveal on the DreadOut 10th Anniversary Steam Sale Page and on our YouTube channel:

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png[/img]
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: Limited Alpha 1.02 is open for playtesting
notes.notes:
Dear valued agents,

This is Mia, your mission operator on a trainee. I would like to inform you firsthand that from Sept 23th until 27th, we’re going to test our recent **game modifiers** utilizing **the modified tarot cards.** Also, some of the tweaked equipment and tools can be observed here. We can not rest easy until all of us are ready for the actual mission later. 

Even though this is only a training ground for all our future agents, please be careful. All of the agents that have already signed up, please be ready for that date. Tell your friends, family, and colleagues to be a part of this. Among you, some of the investigators will also join the training. So don’t hesitate to press F6 and report if you find any unusual anomalies within the training program.

Gear up! Wishlist and See you soon.

Mia.

notes.title: DreadHaunt Demo available now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for checking out our DreadHaunt Demo.
DreadHaunt is our first foray into the online horror multiplayer genre, we are very thrilled to hear what you guys think of our current alpha build Demo. The Demo itself will only available from today until June 20th. The feedback from all of you will be considered and implemented in the final product. 

DreadHaunt [b]will not be[/b] released as free to play games, but instead will be a fully released game with decent enough content to keep us all busy :)

As the development is still in progress, we will continue to improve the final product based on input and suggestions from the community along the way.

After the final product is released, and If the community responds well, we are committed to releasing more content with more game modes, levels, and characters under future DLCs or seasonal passes.

Please consider joining our community for more information and updates.
Appreciate for all of your support.

Much love,
Digital Happiness

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021! 1.1.5 update released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
2020 it’s a really challenging time for all of us, some of our plans and schedules are not well implemented during this unique time. And yet we are very grateful with all of your support, DreadOut 2 is slowly improving and the responses are well received (with 58% mixed reviews during our rocky launch and now 71% mostly positive). 

With 2021 approaching closer as well, we would like to [b]wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021![/b] [b]May you & your loved ones be blessed with joyful heart, happiness in your home, peace in your soul and joy in your life.[/b] Today and always.

Today we have updated [b]DreadOut 2 to version 1.1.5[/b] that contains some minor bug fixes and the most part are adding some new localizations as well. We are adding Hungarian and Spain localization in this update. Shoot out to our friend [b]Brechler Zsolt[/b] who helps us with the Hungarian translation, and [b]Alberto Aniorte R[/b] for Spanish translation. notes.title: The best game you missed in February 2020: DreadOut 2
notes.notes:
As 2020 goes kicking and screaming into that good night, we’ve rounded up some of the best games from the year that we didn’t end up covering. Check the Best Game You Missed tag for more.

I’ve often heard whispers of macabre accounts stemming from Malay and Indonesian folklore – which share some overlaps in supernatural beliefs – as told to me by friends and family alike. Perhaps it’s just sheer proximity to these Southeast Asian cultures that makes these spooks feel more intimate and corporeal, but the spirits in these tales are, to me, more eerie than most garden-variety ghouls. Take, for instance, how even the mere whiff of the frangipani flower can unnerve me, as it’s a scent commonly associated with the pontianak, the vengeful spirit of a pregnant woman who was violently murdered.

In the Indonesian horror game DreadOut 2, these spectres are known as kuntilanak (as they’re referred to in Indonesia). These long-haired, howling spooks are every bit as vicious and frightful as I had imagined them to be, and plenty more such Indonesian ghosts lurk in the city you’ll spend the bulk of your time in in DreadOut 2.

(more…)

notes.title: DreadOut 2 Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Recently, we have an update to further improving DreadOut 2 experience, eliminating further newly founded bugs as well.

This update also contains a major change in terms of Achievement trophy, where we removed BURIK achievement as we have told you in previous DreadOut 2 Version 1.0.1 Update patch notes. The BURIK (an anagram of RUBIK) was a Rubik's cube player need to solve and tied to our achievement. Alas, it just brings headache to all of us, both the solver and the game (as some of you might have experienced, it occasionally missing in the level and shown back upon reloading checkpoints).

We do not have an exact answer as to why it happened so randomly except that it possibly related to the collision and numerical stability of the game engine, hence we removed it completely (both the cube and the achievement). The version is bumped to 1.1.0 from 1.0.1 because of this decision. Hope you understand.

For more complete patch notes, see below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/

Along with this update, we’re still open to any other reports that can potentially reduce your experience while playing DreadOut 2. Stay tuned for more updates from us, as we’re moving into polishing, balancing and tweaking some detail parts that need to be addressed as well.

Thank you for your patience and kind support.
DH

notes.title: DreadOut 2 Available Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

First of all, Thank you for the patience and sorry for the delay, there are some dark spirits corrupted our coding :)

DreadOut 2 is our attempt to make a unique take on a survival horror mix with action, adventure genre with Asian/Indonesian lore, settings, and urban legends, that was being rare presented in video games. With the growing and more diverse content being widely received by gamers, we hope that DreadOut 2 is able to show a small glimpse of our culture in a unique way and get accepted by gamers worldwide, particularly for survival horror fans. 

DreadOut 2 is our labor of love, within 2 years in the making, we put our hearts and souls to bring this for you. There were lots of up and down, joy, tears, and sacrifices to be made across the development. Our small family team of super developers, our small community and endless fans support was one of the reasons that we continue telling a story of DreadOut. DreadOut 2 is by far the most ambitious, passion project by us.  As an indie developer, we have always been clueless with a bigger vision, bigger goals and yet sometimes we often hit the wall. 

DreadOut 2 is far from a perfect product, not everyone would be satisfied with it. But we can only promise to all of you, that we will always do our best to continue improving your experiences along the way.

DreadOut 2 is available now, hope you guys enjoy it as we did enjoy making it. 
Thanks again for everyone's support!

All the best,
Digital Happiness.
